bootstrap.reason_no_persistence_credit: Manifest authority advanced during the invocation and a semantic instruction-scope repair was applied; a fresh post-fix boundary is required.

selected_phase1_slice.reason: Actual durable evidence showed primary_source_verifier fail closed solely because the manifest's 21-path controller registry was interpreted as a per-worker read requirement. The same global interpretation would force CLEAN workers toward unrelated role-control reads and increases startup cost. Long_horizon also failed to emit its new minimal role-local witness on its first post-config11 start, so a cross-pool bootstrap scope correction has higher expected time-to-root value than another role-local route tweak.

before_after_rationale.before: Manifest revision114 defined 21 required instruction paths and wording broad enough for a managed worker to infer it must individually read all 21 before role work. A primary_source_verifier receipt made exactly that inference and terminated after reading 3 paths. Literal application to CLEAN workers would also conflict with their ban on unrelated role-control bodies.
before_after_rationale.after: Manifest revision115 retains all 21 path/blob identities as the optimizer/controller integrity registry. Managed workers must still read manifest and RUN_LIFECYCLE, but then read only the role-specific authority/control paths required by their own current prompt/control. Registry membership alone does not make a path a per-worker read. CLEAN workers remain forbidden from unrelated role-control body reads.
before_after_rationale.expected_effect: Lower bounded startup work for all managed workers, remove a proven false fail-closed condition, preserve controller-wide missing-file detection, and align the manifest with existing role prompts and CLEAN independence.
before_after_rationale.alternative_plan_comparison: Repeating long_horizon config11 unchanged would not address the proven verifier failure. Further shrinking one role's fast path cannot remove a cross-pool manifest ambiguity. Requiring all workers to read 21 paths increases cost and violates CLEAN separation. Scope-splitting the manifest is the smallest transversal correction.

long_horizon.causal_limit: No witness proves the new route did not durably complete, not which bootstrap/read/write operation stopped.

phase1_persistence.reason: Cross-pool bootstrap semantics changed, so only post-fix role-valid executions may count.

rollback.condition: Correct forward if exact post-fix receipts show a role cannot resolve an authority explicitly required by its own prompt/control. Do not reinstate unrelated role-control reads for CLEAN workers, touch self_improvement, disable current managed roles, weaken safety/usefulness/persistence gates, or alter primary/protected authority.

exact_next_action: Next invocation read manifest revision115 first and validate its 21-path controller registry, physically reconcile the 18-role pool without touching self_improvement, then inspect actual first post-fix executions. Verify primary_source_verifier no longer fails merely for not reading unrelated registry paths and verify long_horizon either creates an exact-readback-valid config11 role-local lifecycle witness or emits a narrower role-local blocker. Preserve persistence at 0/2 until a complete current-18 post-fix boundary is role-valid; then require one more consecutive complete boundary.
